name: Eephus Growth Fund I

terms.couponNote: Class A-4. Tiered by class: A-1/A-2 8%, A-3 7%, A-4 6%. Non-compounding, on unreturned capital.
terms.holdNote: PPM states a 5-7 year hold; the economics reconcile at 5.

liquidity.source: Expected sell-down; fund winds up after

structure: Syndicated real estate fund holding several properties. Pays a quarterly preferred return from current income, with an equity share on the sale of the assets.
_about: Global deal facts only. Terms are identical for everyone who bought the same deal, so they live here rather than being retyped by each holder. Nothing personal is in this file: your commitment, funding dates, thesis and notes stay in your own tracker and never leave your machine.
source: Sponsor PPM / summary of terms, as read by the holder. Not verified by GC.
variesNote: Your preferred rate depends on your share class: 8% for A-1 and A-2, 7% for A-3, 6% for A-4. This file carries 6%. The documents do not say what sets the class — if it is ticket size, tell me the breakpoints and the tool will pick your rate automatically. Until then, type your rate into your tracker; what you type wins.

tiers.source: Tiered by share class: A-1/A-2 8%, A-3 7%, A-4 6%. The documents state the RATE per class but not what sets the class, so this cannot be resolved from a commitment yet.
